name: revision_evaluate
description: Score bounded revision-loop candidates and decide retention or escalation.

checks.description: Verification checks for the current candidate. Checks with status 'skipped' are excluded from scoring; unpassed checks with blocking!=false mark the candidate as not auto-eligible.

status.description: Check status; 'skipped' excludes this check from scoring.

weight.description: Relative weight of this check in the checks score.

blocking.description: Whether failing this check blocks auto-eligibility.

findings.description: Review findings for the current candidate; 'critical' severity costs 1.0 and 'major' costs 0.5 off the review score, and either severity disqualifies auto-eligibility.

severity.description: Finding severity, e.g. critical, major, minor.

accepted.description: Whether the candidate was explicitly accepted (e.g. by a judge/reviewer).

weights.description: Score component weights; defaults to {checks: 0.55, review: 0.30, acceptance: 0.15}.

best.description: The best prior candidate result (same shape as this task's output) to compare against; omit on the first round.

minImprovement.description: Minimum score improvement over the prior best to avoid counting toward a plateau.

maxRounds.description: Round number at which the loop is forced to stop (stopReason='round_limit').

budgetExhausted.description: Whether the model/compute budget for this loop has been exhausted; forces stopReason='budget_exhausted' and needsHuman.

plateauCount.description: Prior consecutive-round plateau count to extend.

plateauRounds.description: Consecutive plateaued rounds required before escalate is set.

targetScore.description: Score threshold that, combined with auto-eligibility, sets stopReason='target'.

modelExhausted.description: Whether the assigned model tier is exhausted; forces needsHuman.

score.description: Overall weighted score for this candidate, rounded to 6 decimals.

checksScore.description: Fraction of check weight passed, or null when there are no scored checks.

reviewScore.description: 1.0 minus the finding-severity penalty, floored at 0.

blockingChecksPassed.description: True if no blocking check failed.

autoEligible.description: True if no blocking check failed, the candidate was accepted, and no critical/major finding exists.

retain.description: True if this candidate is better than (or there was no) prior best, so it should be retained.

improvement.description: Score delta versus the prior best (or the raw score when there was no prior), rounded to 6 decimals.

stopReason.description: Why the loop should stop, or 'continue' to keep iterating.

needsHuman.description: True when the loop is exhausted (round limit, budget) or the model tier is exhausted.
